rows.question: Show the evidence of conformity with the acceptance criteria for a released job.
evidence: Acceptance evidence for a released job

rows.question: Who is the person specifically authorized to release, and do they sign the release documents only when all maintenance and inspection operations are complete, to the contract and technical data, with no known nonconformity that would endanger flight safety? Show the release document and the accompanying documentation.
evidence: Release document signed by the authorized person
Confirmation that all operations were completed to the technical data

rows.question: When a maintenance nonconformity is found, what correction is made? Show one example.
evidence: Correction record for a nonconforming output

rows.question: How are nonconforming items segregated, contained, returned or held back from delivery? Show one example.
How is the customer informed of a nonconformity that affects them? Show one example.

Who authorizes acceptance under concession, and has the competent authority and, where applicable, the customer authorized it? How are unsalvageable and counterfeit parts marked, and how is conformity verified after correction?
evidence: Concession authorization by the competent authority
Marking record for unsalvageable or counterfeit parts

rows.question: Does the nonconformity record describe the nonconformity clearly?
Does the record describe the actions taken?
Does the record describe any concession obtained?
Does the record identify the authority that decided the action?
evidence: Nonconformity record with the deciding authority

rows.question: What do you monitor and measure, and how was that decided?
What methods give valid monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation results?
evidence: Method documentation for monitoring and analysis

rows.question: When is each monitoring or measurement performed?
When are results analysed and evaluated? Is QMS performance and effectiveness evaluated, and is the safety performance related to products and services evaluated?
What analysis shows product and service conformity?
What analysis shows the degree of customer satisfaction?
What analysis shows the performance and effectiveness of the QMS?
What analysis shows whether planning has been implemented effectively?
What analysis shows the effectiveness of actions taken for risks and opportunities?
evidence: Risk and opportunity action effectiveness analysis

rows.question: What analysis shows the performance of external providers?
What analysis identifies the need for QMS improvement? Show an example.
evidence: Analysis that led to an improvement need

rows.question: What analysis identifies the need for improvement in product safety management?
evidence: Product safety analysis and its outcome

rows.question: What analysis identifies opportunities to prevent maintenance error? Show an example.
evidence: Maintenance error analysis with prevention action

rows.question: Do the internal audits check conformity to the organization's own QMS requirements, including customer and regulatory requirements, and to the standard?
evidence: Audit criteria covering own requirements and the standard

rows.question: Do the internal audits check that the QMS is effectively implemented and maintained?
Show the audit programme: frequency, methods, responsibilities, planning and reporting, and how it considers process importance, change and previous results.
For one audit, what criteria and scope were defined?
evidence: Audit plan with criteria and scope

rows.question: How are auditors selected so the audit is objective and impartial? Can an auditor audit their own work?
Where are the audit results reported, and to whom?
evidence: Audit report and distribution to management

rows.question: How quickly are audit correction and corrective actions taken? Show one example.
Where is the documented evidence of the audit programme and its results kept?
evidence: Retained audit programme and results records

rows.question: At the last management review, was the status of actions from earlier reviews considered?
At the last management review, were changes in external and internal issues considered?

At the last management review, were the QMS performance trends considered: customer satisfaction, objectives, process performance, nonconformities, measurement, audits, providers and on-time delivery?
evidence: Review input pack showing each trend

rows.question: At the last management review, was the adequacy of resources considered?
At the last management review, was the effectiveness of risk and opportunity actions considered?
evidence: Review input on risk action effectiveness

rows.question: At the last management review, were opportunities for improvement considered?
At the last management review, was product safety performance monitoring considered?
evidence: Review input on product safety performance

rows.question: At the last management review, was the training programme assessed for whether it is adequate, completed and effective?
At the last management review, were upcoming changes in what the competent authority and customers will require, and their effect on the organization, discussed?
evidence: Review input on future requirement changes

rows.question: What decisions and actions on improvement came out of the last management review?
What decisions on changes to the QMS came out of the last management review?
What decisions on resource needs came out of the last management review?
What risks were identified at the last management review, and what happened to them?
Show an improvement that improved products or services to meet future needs and expectations.
Show an action that corrected, prevented or reduced an undesired effect.
Show an improvement that raised the performance and effectiveness of the QMS.
Show an improvement that raised the performance and effectiveness of safety management.
When a nonconformity occurs, how do you react: how is it controlled and corrected, and how are its consequences dealt with?
How do you evaluate the need for action on the cause: review and analysis, causes including human factors, and whether similar nonconformities exist or could occur?
evidence: Root cause analysis including human factors

rows.question: What action was implemented to remove the cause?
How was the effectiveness of the corrective action reviewed?
Were the risks and opportunities updated when the nonconformity was found?
Were changes made to the QMS because of the nonconformity?
evidence: QMS change record linked to the nonconformity

rows.question: Where an external provider was responsible, was the corrective action requirement flowed down to it?
When corrective action was not timely or effective, what specific action was taken? Show the escalation and the documented definition of the process.
evidence: Escalation record for a late or ineffective action
Documented nonconformity and corrective action process

rows.question: Where are the nature of nonconformities and the subsequent actions taken documented?
evidence: Corrective action record with nature and actions

rows.question: Where are the results of corrective actions documented?
